semantics: n <= 65536, seed u32; allocate n zeroed bytes, fill byte[i]=(i+seed) mod 256, return u64 sum and release; empty allocation has no malloc; allocation refusal returns 1001
order: rotate backends by seed index, reverse odd rotations; preserve every sample
decision_rule: No tuning, retries, trimming or best-of selection after measurements.
limits: One bounded owned-buffer kernel, not multiple independent applications.
63 batch samples per backend/size; p99 equals the observed maximum, not per-call p99.
One shared host; affinity does not imply exclusive CPU or stable frequency.
Energy, manual engineering and past tool acquisition are unknown.

rust_pgo.profile_format: LLVM IR instrumentation; exact Rust LLVM/llvm-profdata version match
rust_pgo.warning_policy: enable pgo-warn-missing-function; reject every profile/build warning
rust_pgo.preparation_cost: initial baseline build, instrumentation build, all training calls, cleanup, merge and profile-use rebuild are retained and charged

timing_cohort.classification: New timing lengths and seeds in the available prior structured timing receipts; correctness inputs may previously have been seen.
